record.paper_title: A survey of equivariant map algebras with open problems
record.original_question: Develop representation-theoretic categories for equivariant map algebras beyond finite-dimensional modules, including analogues of category O, categories of integrable highest-weight representations, categories of quasifinite representations with finite-dimensional weight spaces, and other suitable infinite-dimensional module categories.

evidence.quote: (c) Possibly infinite-dimensional representations. Much of the current focus in the study of the representation theory of arbitrary EMAs has been on the category of finite-dimensional representations. However, in specific cases (most importantly, the loop and current algebras) more general categories of representations have been studied.

It would be interesting to study analogous categories in the more arbitrary EMA setting. For example, one could consider the category of integrable highest weight rep- resentations, the category of quasifinite representations (i.e. representations with finite-dimensional weight spaces) or appropriate generalizations of category O.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathfrak{g}$ be a finite-dimensional Lie algebra over $\mathbb{C}$ and let $X$ be a scheme of finite type over $\mathbb{C}$. Let $\Gamma$ be a finite group acting on $\mathfrak{g}$ by Lie algebra automorphisms and on $X$ by scheme automorphisms. The associated equivariant map algebra is
$$M(X,\mathfrak{g})^{\Gamma} = (\mathfrak{g}\otimes_{\mathbb{C}} \mathcal{O}(X))^{\Gamma},$$
the fixed points (under the diagonal action) in the Lie algebra $\mathfrak{g}\otimes\mathcal{O}(X)$, equipped with the bracket $[x\otimes f,\, y\otimes g] = [x,y]\otimes fg$. Special cases include (twisted and untwisted) loop algebras, current algebras, multiloop algebras, and the Onsager algebra.

Most of the existing representation theory of $M(X,\mathfrak{g})^{\Gamma}$ concerns the category of finite-dimensional modules. The problem is to develop a systematic representation theory of suitable infinite-dimensional module categories for arbitrary equivariant map algebras $M(X,\mathfrak{g})^{\Gamma}$. In particular:

(a) Define and study an analogue of category $\mathcal{O}$ for $M(X,\mathfrak{g})^{\Gamma}$, including a triangular decomposition, highest-weight theory, Verma-type modules, and characters.

(b) Define and classify the integrable highest-weight representations of $M(X,\mathfrak{g})^{\Gamma}$.

(c) Define and classify the quasifinite representations of $M(X,\mathfrak{g})^{\Gamma}$, i.e., weight modules whose weight spaces are all finite-dimensional.

(d) Identify and analyze further natural categories of (possibly infinite-dimensional) representations adapted to the equivariant map algebra setting, generalizing the corresponding theories known for loop algebras, current algebras, and affine Kac–Moody algebras.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is a broad research program rather than a single conjecture. Substantial partial progress exists: integrable representations of equivariant map algebras associated with Borel–de Siebenthal pairs have been studied (global Weyl modules), quasifinite irreducible modules over map Virasoro and related algebras have been classified, and integrable representations of root-graded Lie algebras and map extended Witt/Hamiltonian algebras have been investigated. However, a uniform analogue of category O and a complete classification of quasifinite/integrable highest-weight representations for arbitrary equivariant map algebras remain incomplete.

status_evidence.title: Integrable Representations for Equivariant Map Algebras Associated with Borel-de Siebenthal Pairs
status_evidence.snippet: Theory of integrable representations of equivariant map algebras associated with Borel-de Siebenthal pairs, with focus on global Weyl modules.
status_evidence.claim: Integrable representations have been developed in significant special cases.

status_evidence.title: Integrable representations of root-graded Lie algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Studies integrable representations in the broader root-graded setting that includes equivariant map algebras.
status_evidence.claim: Integrable representations partially addressed in related generality.

status_evidence.title: Uniformly bounded weight modules for Map extended Special and Map extended Hamiltonian Lie algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on weight modules for map extended Lie algebras.
status_evidence.claim: Quasifinite/weight module theory continues to be developed for map-type algebras.

status_evidence.title: Representations of map extended Witt algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Studies representations including quasifinite modules over map Virasoro/Witt algebras.
status_evidence.claim: Quasifinite classifications obtained in specific map algebra cases.
